structure.unit: Powers and Duties of Virginia Lottery Board; Administration of Tickets and Prizes

law.catch_line: Disclosure of identity of winners by the Department
law.text: Except as provided in subsection B of § 58.1-4019, the Department shall not disclose information about the identity of an individual lottery winner if the value of the prize won by the winner is $1 million or greater, unless the winner consents in writing to such disclosure.
